title: Bellman-Ford Distance List
description: A directed weighted graph has vertices `0..n-1` and edges `[u,v,w]`; edge weights may be negative. There are no negative-weight cycles reachable from `source`. Return the shortest distance from `source` to every vertex, using -1 for unreachable vertices. Input: `n`, `edges`, `source`. Output: a distance array.
constraints: No negative cycle is reachable from source; all shortest distances fit in signed 32-bit range
hints: Represent each edge as a transition whose cost matches the route rule.
Keep the best distance for each required state and ignore stale priority-queue entries.
